description:
About the job

A LITTLE BIT ABOUT Boldr

Boldr is the first global B-Corp dedicated to delivering world-class Client experiences while creating access to dignified, meaningful work in communities around the world
We are a global team, united by our desire to connect diverse people with common values for boldr impact. 


LET'S START WITH OUR VALUES

Meaningful connections start with AUTHENTICITY
We do our best work by being CURIOUS
We grow by remaining DYNAMIC
Our success combines AMBITIOUS VISION with OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE 
At the heart of great partnerships we'll always find EMPATHY


WHAT IS YOUR ROLE

As a Senior Customer Sales Advocate, you'll embody the determined spirit that characterizes our team. With unwavering confidence, you will proactively engage with prospective customers and guide them through their decision-making journey, working towards converting interest into confirmed customers. Your ability to communicate value clearly and handle multiple conversations with precision will directly contribute to conversion success.

This role blends elements of sales, customer experience, and operational execution. You will manage inbound conversations, follow up with prospects in a structured way, and help ensure a smooth and responsive experience throughout the acquisition journey.


WHY DO WE WANT YOU

We are currently looking for impact-driven individuals who are passionate in helping Boldr grow and achieve our Purpose. We expect our Team to become our ultimate partners to success by always giving their 110% in everything, sharing their talents and quirks, and championing our core values: Curious, Dynamic and Authentic.


WHAT WILL YOU DO

Understand the products inside and out and articulate our value proposition clearly
Conduct system demos to potential clients
Own inbound customer conversations from initial inquiry through conversion, delivering fast, thoughtful, and high-quality responses via chat, email, SMS, and phone
Proactively follow up with leads using structured, multi-touch outreach to re-engage prospects and reduce drop-off
Identify and prioritize high-intent opportunities to focus effort where it drives the most conversion impact
Understand the product offering deeply and clearly articulate value propositions to prospective customers
Conduct guided conversations and product walkthroughs where applicable to support decision-making
Continuously surface insights from customer interactions, including common objections, friction points, and gaps in the experience
Support continuous improvement of messaging, scripts, and conversion workflows by sharing what is and isn't working
Maintain accurate tracking of customer interactions using CRM and communication tools


Requirements




WHAT WE'LL LIKE ABOUT YOU


 YOU ARE...

Curious and authentic, just like us! #beboldr 
An analytical and critical thinker, with an eye for even the most minute of details
Passionate about client satisfaction


YOU HAVE...

1-3 years of experience in a customer-facing role such as sales, support, customer success, or operations
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly and persuasively communicate value
Comfort managing multiple conversations in a fast-paced, high-volume environment
Proactive follow-up habits with strong ownership and accountability
Ability to identify and prioritize high-intent opportunities
Familiarity with CRM or customer communication tools (e.g., Intercom or similar platforms)
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
Ability to learn quickly and adapt in a structured but evolving environment


SHIFT REQUIREMENT

This role operates on a shift schedule covering a 7am-10pm ET operating window, Monday through Friday. Flexibility may be required to support volume surges, PTO coverage, or business needs

description:
About the job

About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

We are looking for an Online Media Manager that owns the planning, supports execution, optimization and measurement of digital media campaigns across our business.

This role will translate campaign briefs and business objectives into actionable digital media plans, working closely with Channel Managers, Marketing teams, Creative teams, Analytics and our media agency.

You will be responsible for ensuring campaigns are properly planned, implemented, monitored and optimized, while turning campaign performance into clear insights and learnings that can improve future media decisions.

We are looking for someone who combines strong digital media fundamentals, is curious about integrated media planning, with analytical thinking, attention to detail and curiosity about how media contributes to marketing and business outcomes.

In this role, you'll be...

Digital Media Planning


Translate campaign briefs and marketing objectives into actionable digital media plans.
Support the development of audience, channel, format and investment recommendations based on campaign objectives.
Work with Senior Media Managers and Channel Managers to ensure media plans follow the overall media strategy and channel best practices.
Integrate relevant business, market, audience and historical campaign learnings into media recommendations.
Ensure digital media planning is connected with the broader integrated campaign and other relevant media channels.



Campaign Execution


Coordinate campaign setup and implementation with media agencies, Channel Managers and internal stakeholders.
Validate that audiences, formats, placements, creative assets, tracking and campaign parameters are correctly implemented before launch.
Coordinate creative asset requirements and ensure media specifications and deadlines are met.
Maintain visibility of campaign status, timelines, deliverables and potential execution risks.
Ensure campaigns are launched according to the approved media strategy and plan.
Campaign Monitoring & Optimization
Monitor campaign performance and investment pacing throughout the campaign lifecycle.
Identify performance opportunities and work with Channel Managers and media agencies to implement optimizations.
Evaluate performance across audiences, placements, formats, creatives and other relevant media variables.
Escalate performance deviations, implementation issues or opportunities that require strategic decisions.
Support testing initiatives across audiences, creatives, formats and media tactics.



Measurement & Insights


Track campaign performance against agreed media and marketing KPIs.
Analyze results to understand what worked, what did not and why.
Go beyond media delivery metrics to identify potential connections between media performance and marketing or business outcomes.
Translate campaign results into clear insights and actionable recommendations.
Develop post-campaign analyses and consolidate learnings that can improve future campaigns.
Share relevant learnings across campaigns, markets and business units.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...


3–5 years of experience in digital media planning, media agencies, or similar roles.
Hands on understanding of major digital media platforms such as Meta, Google Ads, YouTube, TikTok and programmatic media.
Experience developing and executing digital media plans across different campaign objectives.
Strong understanding of digital media metrics including Reach, Frequency, CPM, CPC, CTR, VTR, CPA and conversion metrics.
Ability to analyze campaign performance and translate data into insights and recommendations.
Experience working with campaign budgets, investment pacing and media performance reporting.
Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple campaigns and stakeholders simultaneously.
Strong communication and presentation skills.
Comfortable working with Excel/Google Sheets and media reporting or visualization tools.
Ability to work in a fast paced, collaborative and constantly evolving environment.
English proficiency sufficient to collaborate with regional and global teams.



It would be a plus if you have…


Experience working across CPG,Tech, Fintech, Streaming, DTC verticals 
Experience with app-based businesses, marketplaces, food delivery, mobility, fintech or e-commerce.
Familiarity with Brand Lift studies, conversion studies or other media effectiveness measurement solutions.
Experience working with first-party audiences or audience segmentation.
Familiarity with experimentation and test-and-learn methodologies.
Experience working across multiple markets or business units.



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

The successful candidate will drive cost optimization, supplier performance, risk management, and continuous improvement while supporting client business objectives across regional and global markets.

Support supplier selection, onboarding, performance management, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Maintain awareness of industry trends, supplier innovations, and emerging opportunities within marketing and corporate travel markets.
Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, stakeholders, and suppliers to support successful sourcing outcomes.


Requirements


Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Procurement, Supply Chain, Marketing, Finance, or a related field.
Minimum 3-5 years of sourcing, procurement, or category management experience.
Experience sourcing marketing, media, advertising, production, corporate travel, meetings and events, or related professional services categories.
Proven experience managing RFIs, RFQs, RFPs, supplier evaluations, negotiations, and contract management activities.
Strong understanding of marketing services, media buying, and corporate travel supplier markets.
Experience conducting spend analysis, benchmarking, and commercial evaluations to support sourcing decisions.
Strong negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to manage multiple sourcing projects simultaneously and deliver results within agreed timelines.
Experience working with procurement systems, sourcing tools, and Microsoft Excel, including data analysis and reporting.

Join a truly global team.

We offer a dynamic and international environment where high performance meets real purpose. We're proud to be Great Place to Work-certified and even prouder of the people who make that possible. Let’s shape the future of procurement - together.

Physical Environment

This position operates in an open office working environment which will include normal and customary distractions, noise, and interruptions.

High School Diploma or equivalent *Bachelors degree in Marketing or related field.

Experience Requirements

related experience creating and managing paid display and social campaigns, including management of DV360, Facebook, Twitter, and YouTube. Demonstrated experience in performance marketing and ability to work across marketing department functions. Track record of successful vendor management.

Additional Qualification

Demonstrated analytical skills. Ability to synthesize complex data sets into actionable steps/initiatives *Demonstrated time management and priority setting skills. About the job

About the Role

Millions of people rely on digital maps every day to navigate, to discover, to find their way. But maps are only as accurate as the data behind them, and data is only as trustworthy as the people who verify it. Your knowledge of Mexico's geography, local landmarks, and how people actually navigate your region is something no algorithm can fully replicate. That local intelligence is what makes maps genuinely useful.




Why This Matters

Accurately verified mapping data prevents real-world navigation errors. Your verification work ensures that:

Users can discover trusted businesses and cultural landmarks with confidence
Communities can navigate with accurate, culturally-informed geographic intelligence
Geographic data quality scales across millions of locations and thousands of data variations

At scale, this is infrastructure work. Every verified data point contributes to how billions of people interact with geographic information globally.




What You'll Do

Core Responsibilities

Structured Quality Audits on Spatial Datasets

Conduct detailed, methodical evaluations of geographic and business data entries using advanced mapping platforms and GIS-standard evaluation tools
Assess spatial data points (coordinates, boundaries, locations) for accuracy and consistency across multiple authoritative sources
Verify business information (names, hours, categories, contact details, service offerings) against primary and secondary sources
Evaluate cultural and regional context—ensuring data reflects how Mexicans actually navigate, describe, and interact with their geographic environment

About the job

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

Clari + Salesloft are building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we’re building the industry’s first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.

With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

At Clari + Salesloft, our Senior Data Analysts are pivotal to our company's success. You will be a leader within our fast-growing and high-performing Data & Analytics team, responsible for driving departments to monitor their performance, understand trends, and make more informed decisions.

On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible for owning the delivery of actionable insights that drive positive change across the business. Specifically, you will:


Leverage complex datasets to identify and quantify key performance indicators. 
Create dashboards and data visualizations that monitor & measure success. 
Establish and own best practices & training materials for data-savvy users within functional departments. 
Be a key leader in championing the impact of data, company-wide.


In addition to working with amazing colleagues who exemplify our ‘team over self’ core value, you will also have the opportunity to [EXAMPLE: sell an impactful and revolutionary software that is changing the way sellers sell.] You will have an opportunity to make a difference.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

We are seeking a highly experienced, results-oriented Senior Data Analyst who can empower the business to make better decisions with data. We are interested in people who are equal parts analytically focused and business-driven, motivated by solving real-world problems and exploring new approaches.

If you’re looking for an opportunity to learn more, do more, and become more, then becoming a Senior Data Analyst is the career path for you!

THE TEAM:

Our Clari + Salesloft Data & Analytics team is composed of Data Analysts & Data Engineers who are all aligned on one mission: to redefine the Sales Engagement space and activate the authentic seller in all of us.

The Data & Analytics team consists of passionate data engineers and analysts with a drive to enable Salesloft to make better decisions. Our team shares a few common traits: they are accountable, unafraid to experiment, and continuously learning.

THE SKILL SET:


5+ years in a Data Analyst or similar role
Expert-level proficiency in SQL and using it to create derivative data structures
Experience with a data visualization tool (Sigma knowledge is preferred; Tableau or Looker is also a plus)
Proven track record of using data to drive significant transformations in business processes
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to distill complex ideas and present them with influence to non-data focused individuals and leadership.
Past experience in a SaaS business model is preferred
Experience using dbt/Python/R/Git is a plus
Proficient in AI model implementation or highly motivated to develop expertise in the field

title: Senior Product Manager - Social Experience
skills: Design complete social journeys. Work through how someone discovers a person, decides to follow them, shares an idea or trade, receives a response, and returns. Connect these interactions into an experience users understand without explanation.

Make the interaction details work. Shape navigation, information hierarchy, copy, defaults, gestures, and feedback. Specify what happens when a feed is empty, a post fails, content loads slowly, or someone changes their mind.

Prototype before committing to a build. Turn ideas into interactive prototypes that communicate the intended behavior. Explore alternatives, test the uncertain parts, and give engineering clear flows, states, and acceptance criteria.

Use psychology to improve participation. Understand why people hesitate to post, seek recognition, follow strangers, or respond to others. Translate those motivations into decisions about audience visibility, prompts, reputation, feedback, and the effort required to contribute.

Observe users and fix what gets in their way. Run usability sessions, watch people complete tasks, and combine those observations with funnel data. Identify where people misunderstand the product, lose confidence, or abandon an action.

Design for first use and repeated use. Make the experience useful before someone has connections. Keep sharing lightweight during an active trading session, with clear control over what becomes public. Test the twentieth interaction as carefully as the first.

Connect design decisions to measurable outcomes. For each significant change, define the expected behavior and how to test it. Track task completion, abandonment, first follows, first contributions, responses, and subsequent retention. Work with data science to evaluate experiments and effects on both contributors and their audiences.

Take the experience through launch. Choose a focused initial scope, resolve trade-offs with engineering, review the implementation against the intended design, and use post-launch evidence to decide what to improve next.

Has designed and shipped consumer social experiences. Your portfolio shows your contribution to feeds, profiles, sharing, messaging, discovery, or communities—and how the experience changed after launch.

Has strong interaction design craft. You can explain why a flow is structured a particular way, what users will notice first, what they need to understand, and which decisions or steps can be removed.
Can build realistic interactive prototypes. You use Figma, code, AI tools, or a combination to make behavior tangible and testable, including transitions, empty states, and failure states.
Understands behavior through evidence. You can show where user research challenged your assumptions and changed a design.
Can own product outcomes. You can prioritize a problem, define success, interpret funnel and cohort data, and explain whether an experiment produced a meaningful improvement.
Understands the context of social finance. You account for how credibility, incentives, reputation, and visibility of financial activity affect what people trust and choose to share.

Who We Are

At Justworks, you’ll enjoy a welcoming and casual environment, great benefits, wellness program offerings, company retreats, and the ability to interact with and learn from leaders in the startup community. We work hard and care about our most prized asset - our people.

We’re helping businesses get off the ground by enabling them to focus on running their business. We solve HR issues. We’re data-driven and never stop iterating. Our Values

If this sounds like you, you’ll fit right in.

You are self-driven and like to work with others to remove roadblocks. You are curious and love to explore and learn new technologies. You will join a small, highly autonomous cross-functional team to build AI agents that fundamentally transform how operations work at scale. Instead of writing bespoke software for every workflow, we are developing an agent platform that can read operational knowledge, reason about it in context, and execute tasks end-to-end. This approach allows us to scale complexity through knowledge and reasoning, rather than simply through code.

This is an opportunity to join a foundational team, which currently consists of fewer than five engineers. The work spans critical areas including LLM-powered agent design, robust backend service architecture, tool and integration development, and sophisticated knowledge infrastructure.

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with a strong passion for building AI-native systems in a product environment. The ideal candidate will be able to take ownership of large segments of the technology stack, make pragmatic technical decisions in ambiguous and emerging territory, and consistently ship high-quality, production-ready systems that our users rely on every day.

Design, build, and own core components of the agent platform, from the orchestration layer to the tool integrations connecting it to internal systems.
Build and evolve the capabilities layer: APIs, data access patterns, and service integrations for agents to execute operational workflows.
Architect the knowledge and memory infrastructure, allowing agents to retrieve the data and act across our systems.
Design and implement the trust and safety framework, including audit trails, human-in-the-loop controls, and guardrails for safe and auditable AI-driven operations.
Contribute to agent evaluation and testing infrastructure, defining how we measure accuracy, reliability, and regression across agent behaviors.
Partner directly with Operations to understand workflows, identify automation opportunities, and translate process knowledge into agent capabilities.
Mentor other engineers on the team as it grows.

About the candidate

You are comfortable in a fast-paced, early-stage environment. You demonstrate a "scrappy" and resourceful approach, proactively identifying solutions and unblocking yourself without needing a fully defined path.
You are pragmatic and balance quality with speed. You understand when to optimize for long-term durability and when to iterate quickly. You prioritize pragmatism over being overly precious about code, but never compromise on quality in a way that creates future issues.
You are product-minded. You look beyond the immediate task, seeking to understand the "why" behind the build and questioning whether it's the right product solution. You are comfortable contributing product thinking alongside engineering work.
You demonstrate a strong ownership mindset. You are proactive, identify gaps, and drive initiatives to completion without waiting for explicit instructions. When encountering issues or ambiguity, you address them directly.
You possess strong backend engineering fundamentals. You can confidently design, build, and operate production systems.
You are curious and eager to develop expertise in AI and LLMs. While deep research is not required, you are motivated to build practical, real-world products using these tools, specifically focusing on agent systems.
Qualifications
5+ years of backend engineering experience building and operating production systems
Hands-on experience with LLMs and AI agents (orchestration, RAG, tool/function calling, or similar)
Strong API design and system integration skills
Product-minded: questions requirements and contributes to product decisions, not just execution
Proven ownership of complex projects in ambiguous, early-stage environments
Technologies Used
Golang, Ruby on Rails, Javascript, Java, C#, Python, VueJS, MySQL, Kafka, AWS, Git, Memcache, Redis, ElasticSearch, Docker, Terraform, Kubernetes, CircleCI, DataDog

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. We are seeking a Product Marketing Associate to join a small, hands-on Product Marketing team that owns growth strategy and go-to-market execution across Sezzle’s shopper-facing product ecosystem, spanning financial products to engagement and rewards. The team is lean by design: every product marketer owns a real portfolio from day one, works directly with the data, and partners daily with Product, Data, Design, and Marketing Communications to turn research into shipped, measurable growth.

Overall category strategy is set in partnership with the Head of Product Marketing; you’ll own how that strategy comes to life for each individual product in your portfolio, from discovery through launch, optimization, and iteration. This role is well-suited for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, values structured thinking, and is excited to take ownership of meaningful product initiatives. While this role is aligned to a defined group of products, prioritization is driven by company-level goals and key performance metrics, not equal attention across every surface. You’ll work closely with cross-functional partners to continuously assess where Product Marketing efforts will have the greatest impact and dynamically allocate time and resources accordingly — meaning some products or initiatives may require deeper focus at different points in time.

The salary range for this role is $2.000 - $2.900 per month (Gross in USD)

Partner in conducting user research (surveys, user testing, etc,) and own the analysis, turning results into clear, actionable insight

Monitor adoption and engagement post-launch, flagging risks and identifying iteration opportunities
Treat everything as a test. Whether you're launching something new or optimizing something existing, you should always be designing for learning, monitoring results, and iterating based on what the data tells you

Work closely with Product Managers and Marketing Communications on every product you touch. These are your primary partners for testing, launching, and improving
Navigate across Product, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, Data, Design, and Marketing to move work forward
Adapt priorities quickly as business needs shift 
Contribute to team documentation so insights and learnings can be shared across teams


Qualifications

Required


1–2 years of experience in Product Marketing, Growth, Consumer Research, or a related field.
Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with qualitative feedback, behavioral data, and survey results
Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
Clear, concise communicator who can turn complexity into a sharp insight or recommendation
Curious about AI tools and eager to use them to work smarter. Bonus if you're already using them regularly


Nice to Have


Consumer-facing or mobile product experience
Familiarity with user research methodologies, NPS analysis, or customer interview programs
Experience with lifecycle messaging, in-product copy, or Braze (or similar)
Background in fintech, subscriptions, or marketplace businesses

You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

description:
About the job

HoopStars | Parent-company Marketing Team Lead

Full-time. Remote from LATAM. Toronto working hours. Potential future relocation to the US or Canada by mutual agreement.

Build the business. Build the marketing team.

HoopStars is a Toronto-based youth basketball business with recurring customers and technology-enabled operations. We are looking for a hands-on General Manager whose strongest skills are marketing, ecommerce and profitable growth, and who can take responsibility for the whole business.

You will divide your time approximately equally between running HoopStars and building and managing the parent company Community Sports Partners' marketing team across its brands. This is one vacancy advertised across multiple locations. Candidates elsewhere in LATAM are also welcome; apply once using your preferred location listing.

You should understand how to turn advertising into customers, improve conversion, increase repeat purchases and make the numbers work. You will also own budgets, operating performance and the team delivering the customer experience.

What You Will Own


Run HoopStars: Own its business plan, budget, revenue, profitability and cash forecasts. Lead sales and operations, ensuring programmes, coaches, venues and service quality keep pace with demand
Drive digital growth: Improve paid search and social, creative, landing pages, enrollment funnels, pricing, offers, referrals and retention
Build the parent marketing team: Define the structure, recruit specialists, appoint contractors or agencies where useful, and manage priorities and performance across brands
Establish commercial discipline: Connect campaign performance to paying customers, repeat enrollment and contribution profit. Allocate marketing investment using reliable reporting and testing
Stay close to execution: Inspect advertising accounts, diagnose funnel problems and help launch improvements yourself while building a team that can execute consistently


Support and autonomy

The parent provides bookkeeping assistance, HR support, IT and website support, and a local manager covering customer service and day-to-day sales. You will propose budgets and team plans, then make operating decisions within agreed authority. After onboarding, the founder expects a monthly business review, supported by clear weekly reporting and escalation of exceptional issues.

Your first 90 days

Understand the customers, operations and economics. Audit marketing across the brands. Establish reporting, propose the marketing team structure and hiring priorities, launch the first growth tests, and take ownership of normal HoopStars business decisions.

Requirements

Who we are looking for

You may have built an ecommerce business, led growth for a consumer brand, run a digital agency with meaningful operating responsibility, or managed a business where digital acquisition was central to its success.


Demonstrated results in paid acquisition, conversion and retention

About The Team

We are looking for an experienced Senior Marketing Technologist or Marketing Data Engineer in the Marketing Tech and Operations space to help build highly coordinated and efficient infrastructure that powers Zillow's marketing organization. We serve as technical liaison between marketing, product, engineering, and marketing vendor teams to bring all partners together toward a common goal. As part of the CDP team, you will integrate with and operate on various marketing systems and will be a key point person for data infrastructure that supports critical marketing initiatives and campaigns.

This role performs a combination of hands-on-keyboard work and technical program management, working collaboratively to deliver capabilities and empower our customers. The ideal candidate shines in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment, and has a balance of program management and hands-on technical skills. If you like solving complex problems and are passionate about enabling marketing teams and delivering the vision of Zillow 2.0, we want to hear from you!

About The Role

You will get to:


Play a key role in the configuration of the Customer Data Platform and other marketing systems to enable centralized customer data management and power marketing campaigns

Coordinate with other dev dependencies to align cross-tech team sprint schedules
Document and maintain standardized and efficient processes, automating as much as possible


This role has been categorized as a teleworker position. Teleworkers do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and instead work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. Employees may live anywhere in Mexico, with availability to travel to Mexico City, as we recommend attendance at occasional office events.

In addition to a competitive base salary and benefits, this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location.

Who you are


Gravitate toward the detail but can keep the big picture in focus
Very comfortable with analyzing and structuring large datasets
Highly analytical approach, using data to drive step-change results
Experience in agile methodology and program management tools like JIRA
Proven track record of leading cross-functional groups to deliver quality products on time
Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to lead and prioritize multiple projects with little supervision
Able to proactively identify dependencies/blockers and work with engineering teams to mitigate risk
Exhibit a collaborative working style with a strong focus on execution and results
Strong interpersonal skills, effective in communicating with both technical and non-technical partners
Ability to influence without direct authority and partner with cross-functional teams to achieve shared goals
Have the modesty to question assumptions, seek broad input, and validate iteratively
Dedicated to operational excellence, clear communication and take ownership of your work


Qualifications


5+ years experience in Engineering, Analytics, Tech Operations, or Marketing Technologist role, leading technical programs across cross-functional teams to deliver scalable platforms and services
Expertise in SQL and relational databases required; Python or other programming languages preferred
Hands-on experience with ETL tools, cloud services (AWS s3 and lambda), and API integrations
Nice to have: experience with marketing platforms (CDP, ESP, Google/Facebook APIs) and CRM tools (Hubspot, Marketo, Salesforce)
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Operations Management, or similar field preferred, or equivalent experience


Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company that's reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S.. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

Zillow Group is committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and to providing equal employment opportunities. We comply with applicable laws that prohibit discrimination in employment and recruitment.

If you have a disability or special need that requires reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact your recruiter directly.

Qualified applicants will be considered for employment based on their qualifications and ability to perform the functions of the position, without discrimination and in accordance with applicable law.

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. description:
About the job

As our first dedicated Product Manager, you will shape the future of the platform that’s at the core of how Designity operates and delivers value. You will develop a deep understanding of our users and platform, identify the opportunities that matter most, establish a clear product roadmap, and help turn those priorities into improvements that help us scale.




Designity is a premium, AI-enabled and human-led Creative-as-a-Service company. We help brands scale creative and marketing work through dedicated Creative Director-led teams. Our model brings together senior creative leadership, multidisciplinary talent, managed execution, and AI-enabled workflows so clients can move faster without lowering the standard.




Why this role exists

Our platform is at the core of Designity’s success. It connects our clients, creatives, and internal teams, and plays a critical role in how we deliver our service efficiently and at scale.




As Designity grows, we need to make sure the platform grows with us. That means continuously improving the experience, solving friction, identifying new opportunities, and making thoughtful product decisions that support both our users and the business.




Today, it is built primarily on no-code technology, giving us the flexibility to evolve quickly as our business and user needs change. The opportunity now is to bring dedicated product leadership to how we prioritize, improve, and scale it further.




What you will be doing:

Shape the product direction: Own product strategy, roadmap, and execution across Designity's platform experiences.
Turn needs into priorities: Translate business goals, user feedback, and platform needs into clear product priorities that balance user value with business impact.
Find opportunities to improve: Evaluate existing systems, workflows, and product experiences to identify friction, uncover opportunities, and recommend practical solutions.
Keep the roadmap focused: Create and maintain a prioritized product backlog, making thoughtful decisions based on business impact, user value, effort, and strategic priorities.
Define what we build: Collaborate closely with leadership and internal teams to turn ideas and business needs into clear product requirements for new features and improvements.

What you will bring:

Strong product strategy skills, including roadmap development, prioritization, backlog management, requirements definition, and translating business objectives into product decisions.
A solid understanding of how no-code products work, including workflows, data relationships, automations, integrations, capabilities, and limitations.
Ability to prototype, test, and iterate quickly using no-code and AI-native tools.
The ability to identify high-impact near-term opportunities while maintaining a clear long-term product vision.
A strong analytical and problem-solving mindset, with the ability to turn complex business and user challenges into practical product solutions.
Experience managing products that serve multiple user groups is highly preferred.
Comfortable working with lean, cross-functional teams without large organizational structures
Strong ownership, initiative, and adaptability in an environment where priorities and opportunities can evolve quickly.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to create clarity around priorities, requirements, decisions, and tradeoffs.




How we work:

Designity is remote, with a structured virtual office environment built for close collaboration, clear communication, and meaningful connection. This role is open across LATAM, Europe, and South Africa.




To support collaboration with our team and U.S.-based clients, you will need to be available during our core collaboration window of 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM Eastern Time (ET).




What this role offers:

The opportunity to become Designity's first dedicated Product Manager and shape how the product function develops.
Ownership over a platform that is central to Designity's operations, client experience, and continued growth.
The ability to experiment with AI-native tools and new approaches to product exploration and prototyping.
Collaboration with global teams in a multicultural environment.
A fully remote environment with structured virtual collaboration.
Paid time off to rest and recharge.
Professional growth and continued skill development.
A fast-moving, supportive environment that values initiative, experimentation, accountability, and high standards.

Choose Positivity and lift those around you.
Say It Straight with honesty and respect.
Raise the Bar by never settling for average.
Take Ownership of your work and your impact.
Move with Purpose and make every action count.




Success in this role means:

Building a product roadmap that connects user needs and business priorities with Designity's long-term growth.
Making the platform an increasingly powerful driver of efficiency, scalability, and user experience.
Developing a deep understanding of clients, creatives, and internal teams and ensuring their most important needs inform product decisions.
Identifying high-impact opportunities and turning them into meaningful, measurable product improvements.
Creating clear priorities and tradeoffs so teams understand what we are building, why it matters, and what success looks like.
Using data, user feedback, and product judgment to continuously improve the platform.
Balancing immediate opportunities with the longer-term scalability and evolution of the Designity product.

title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
About the job

🚀 Buscamos un/a Customer Support Specialist L1 en México para sumarse a AgendaPro.




AgendaPro es la plataforma líder en LATAM para gestionar agenda, pagos y crecimiento en negocios de belleza, salud y bienestar, con más de 12 años creciendo y respaldo de Y Combinator y una Serie B de US$35M.




Estamos en plena transformación: pasamos de un SaaS horizontal a un modelo de verticales con agentes de IA, y estamos armando los equipos que van a llevar estas nuevas líneas de negocio al mercado. Es una etapa temprana donde todavía hay muchísimo por construir, probar y escalar y queremos que seas parte desde el principio.




Buscamos gente con ganas de aprender, actitud resolutiva y vocación de servicio, que entienda que detrás de cada conversación hay un emprendedor confiando en nosotros.




📍 Modalidad híbrida – con esquema de turnos: días presenciales con entrada a las 09:00 y fines de semana remoto.




Tu desafío: Ser la primera línea de soporte vía chat (Intercom) y resolver los problemas de nuestros clientes con rapidez, claridad y empatía. Cada conversación bien resuelta es un cliente que se queda.




🚀 Qué harás / Responsabilidades:

• Atención en Intercom (tu cancha principal): gestionar tu bandeja de conversaciones, tomar casos y responder en tiempo real.

• Comunicarte con clientes por chat (canal principal) y, ocasionalmente, por mail, teléfono o videollamada.

• Ser el reflejo de la marca en cada mensaje: claro, empático y paciente, sobre todo con clientes poco tecnologizados.

• Resolver consultas de usabilidad guiando al cliente paso a paso dentro de AgendaPro.

• Crear y documentar tickets internos con todo el detalle cuando corresponda.

• Trabajar junto a Tecnología y Producto para que los errores se resuelvan rápido, sin perder nunca el seguimiento con el cliente.

• Cumplir las métricas del área: CSAT, tiempo de primera respuesta (FRT), tiempo de resolución y productividad diaria.

• Participar en capacitaciones, QA y mejora continua de flujos y respuestas.




Requisitos:

• Pasión real por el servicio al cliente: no descansas hasta dejar al usuario con su problema resuelto.

• Excelente comunicación escrita en español: sabes explicar lo complejo de forma simple.

• Habilidad tecnológica básica: navegadores, correo, hojas de cálculo y varias pestañas/herramientas abiertas a la vez sin marearte.

• Comodidad para revisar configuraciones y guiar al cliente en las suyas.

• Proactividad, paciencia, empatía y aguante para manejar varias conversaciones a la vez.

• Disponibilidad para el esquema de turnos (presencial con entrada a las 09:00 y remoto los fines de semana).




Suma puntos (no excluyente):

• Experiencia en atención al cliente, ventas o customer success en empresas de tecnología / SaaS.

• Conocimiento de herramientas tipo Intercom, Zendesk o CRMs.

• Nociones de web, APIs, redes o tecnología en general.

• Inglés intermedio.

description:
About the job

YouTube isn't a campaign type here. It's a dedicated channel with its own team.


Salary: $3,750 USD/month

At most agencies, YouTube is a line item inside "Google Ads management." A campaign type. Something the search team turns on when the client asks about video or the Meta team builds it out.

At Taikun, YouTube is its own service line. Its own strategy, its own creative discipline, its own measurement design. We built it that way on purpose, because the channel deserves it and because treating YouTube like Meta is how you burn $50k learning nothing.




That decision is why brands doing $5M to $500M a year hire us for YouTube specifically. We run geo holdouts to prove lift. We publish quarterly research on the channel. We are at the forefront of YouTube tools like CTV Premiere Beta, YouTube Creator Partnerships, and Insights Finder.

We're not looking for someone who wants to learn this. We're looking for someone who already lives it and wants a bigger stage to run on.




About Taikun

We're a fully remote ~30-person performance marketing agency and Google Premier Partner, built for DTC ecommerce. Your work ships under your name, and some of it gets published for the whole industry to read.




What you'll actually do

You'll own YouTube strategy and execution for DTC accounts.

The role:

Build true full-funnel YouTube programs. Awareness through conversion across in-stream, in-feed, Shorts, and Demand Gen, with each stage doing a distinct job instead of 1 campaign pretending to do all of them.
Design sequencing strategies. Story arcs across ad exposures. You know how to architect this and when it's worth the complexity.
Deploy contextual and audience targeting with intent. Placements, topics, custom segments, in-market layers. You match the message to the moment, not just the person.

Brief creative that converts. Hook first. Emotion first, logic second.
Catch the lies early. Conversion inflation, view-through padding, saturation creep. You'll spot them before the client ever sees a weird number.
Report like a strategist. Weekly reads that separate real CAC from reported CAC, written so a founder actually understands them.
Your findings feed our quarterly YouTube reports and frameworks. Your work builds your reputation, not just ours.




Who this is for
You've run YouTube hands-on for 3+ years as your primary channel, ideally on DTC accounts spending $100k+ a month. Not YouTube as a side quest inside a Google Ads role. YouTube as the job.
You've built sequenced, full-funnel programs before and have opinions about when sequencing earns its complexity and when it doesn't.
You speak incrementality fluently. Holdouts, lift tests, MMM calibration, and why last-click fails to flatter a video channel. Every, single, time.
You have taste. You can watch a cut and know in 6 seconds whether it'll hold attention, and you can explain why.
You write like you talk. Clear, direct, no jargon. Clients hire us for clarity as much as performance.

Bonus points
Demand Gen experience and the scars that come with its reporting quirks
A DTC background, so you can translate for brands shifting spend
SQL, Python, or scripting chops for reporting automation
A public footprint. You've posted, published, or podcasted about this work (not mandatory).




Why this job is different

You've probably been the only person at your company who really understands YouTube. Here, we’re building an entire team around it. A dedicated service line, the sharpest measurement stack in the DTC agency world, direct access to leadership, and a byline on research the industry actually reads. About the job

Job Category

Marketing & Communications

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the world's #1 AI CRM, helping companies of every size and industry connect with their customers in a whole new way. Founded in 1999 and headquartered in San Francisco, Salesforce is a Fortune 500 company with over 70,000 employees worldwide, serving more than 150,000 customers globally.

Our platform — spanning Sales, Service, Marketing, Commerce, Analytics, and more — is trusted by companies from startups to Fortune 500s to build stronger customer relationships, drive growth, and create meaningful impact. At Salesforce, we believe business is the greatest platform for change, and our values — Trust, Customer Success, Innovation, Equality, and Sustainability — guide everything we do.

We're growing our Creative & Brand organization in Mexico City, and we're looking for bold, systems-driven design leaders to shape how Salesforce looks, moves, and communicates at scale.

About The Role

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Motion Design to lead the origination of foundational motion identity systems for Salesforce's global brand. This is not a production or execution role — this is a strategic, systems-level design leadership position based in Mexico City.

In this role, you will be responsible for architecting repeatable "motion DNA" and scalable toolkits that creative teams across the globe can adopt, adapt, and build upon. You will also pioneer Agentic Creativity at Salesforce, leveraging a cutting-edge AI stack to scale these systems 30% faster while preserving the human brand craft that defines our visual identity.

What You'll Do

Strategic Motion System Design


Originate and architect foundational motion identity systems that serve as the repeatable "motion DNA" for Salesforce's global brand
Develop systemic motion toolkits, templates, and frameworks that enable global creative teams to self-serve with consistency
Define and govern motion standards, ensuring 100% brand compliance across all system outputs
Shift the team's creative output so that 40% is dedicated purely to systemic origination — moving away from one-off execution toward scalable, reusable infrastructure


Agentic Creativity & AI-Powered Workflows


Pioneer the use of an advanced AI stack to accelerate motion design workflows at enterprise scale
Bridge traditional motion tools (e.g., After Effects) with modern generative AI and agentic workflows
Drive a 30% increase in system production speed without sacrificing brand integrity or human craft
Evaluate and implement emerging AI-powered motion technologies as the creative landscape evolves

Communicate design decisions with clarity, persuasion, and executive-level fluency in English

Lead and inspire a team of motion designers, establishing a culture of systemic thinking and creative innovation
Mentor designers in both traditional craft and AI-augmented workflows
Set quality standards and KPI frameworks to measure the systemic impact of the team's output


Required Qualifications

What We're Looking For


10+ years of world-class motion design experience, with a demonstrated portfolio of systems-level, brand-defining work
Proven track record of originating motion identity systems — not just executing videos or adapting existing assets
Deep expertise in After Effects and the broader Adobe Creative Suite
Hands-on experience with generative AI tools applied to motion and video workflows

Demonstrated ability to present design strategy and systems to senior and C-level stakeholders
Experience working in a global, matrixed organization
Advanced Stack & AI Generative Mastery: full command of the contemporary AI creative stack, including tools like Kling 3.0, Veo 3.1, Luma Agents, and Runway Gen-4.5. 
Ability to build custom, AI-native generative workflows that prioritize brand soul over generic output, successfully bridging traditional motion tools like After Effects (used for final quality checks) with modern production models. 


Preferred Qualifications


Experience leading motion design at a global technology or enterprise software company
Background in brand systems design (not just campaign or video production contexts)
Knowledge of prompt engineering for AI-assisted visual and motion content generation
Experience building and scaling creative toolkits for geographically distributed teams

This role is KPI-driven. Performance will be evaluated against the following metrics:


Executive approval rate on original motion systems: 70% on first presentation
Brand compliance rate across all system outputs: 100%
Team output dedicated to systemic origination: 40% of total output
Production speed improvement via AI stack: 30% faster vs. baseline


Why Salesforce

Joining Salesforce means joining a company that puts its values into action every day.

As a Senior Manager, Motion Design in Mexico City, you will:


Define how one of the world's most recognized enterprise brands moves and feels globally
Work at the frontier of AI-augmented creative workflows, alongside world-class designers and technologists
Build systems that scale your craft across markets, teams, and platforms
Be part of a company consistently recognized as one of the World's Most Innovative Companies and a Best Place to Work
Grow your career within a global organization committed to equality, innovation, and sustainability

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

About the job

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About The Role

We are seeking a Product Marketing Associate to join a small, hands-on Product Marketing team that owns growth strategy and go-to-market execution across Sezzle’s shopper-facing product ecosystem, spanning financial products to engagement and rewards. The team is lean by design: every product marketer owns a real portfolio from day one, works directly with the data, and partners daily with Product, Data, Design, and Marketing Communications to turn research into shipped, measurable growth.

Overall category strategy is set in partnership with the Head of Product Marketing; you’ll own how that strategy comes to life for each individual product in your portfolio, from discovery through launch, optimization, and iteration. This role is well-suited for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, values structured thinking, and is excited to take ownership of meaningful product initiatives. While this role is aligned to a defined group of products, prioritization is driven by company-level goals and key performance metrics, not equal attention across every surface. You’ll work closely with cross-functional partners to continuously assess where Product Marketing efforts will have the greatest impact and dynamically allocate time and resources accordingly — meaning some products or initiatives may require deeper focus at different points in time.

The salary range for this role is $2.000 - $2.900 per month (Gross in USD)

What You’ll Do

Insight Generation & Research


Partner in conducting user research (surveys, user testing, etc,) and own the analysis, turning results into clear, actionable insight
Analyze qualitative and quantitative user data to surface patterns, friction points, and opportunities across your product portfolio within Earn and rewards
Bring a genuine Gen Z consumer perspective to how we frame problems, develop messaging, and evaluate product experiences
Use AI tools to accelerate insight generation and sharpen the inputs that shape growth strategy and marketing plans


Strategy & Execution


Own product marketing for your assigned products, both new and existing, supporting the full lifecycle: Discover & Validate, Shape & Plan, Launch & Learn, Optimize & Scale
Translate overall Earn and rewards category strategy into product-specific positioning and messaging, grounded in behavioral data and user research
Develop and execute GTM plans across in-app surfaces, lifecycle messaging, and marketing channels
Monitor adoption and engagement post-launch, flagging risks and identifying iteration opportunities
Treat everything as a test. Whether you're launching something new or optimizing something existing, you should always be designing for learning, monitoring results, and iterating based on what the data tells you


Cross-Functional Collaboration


Work closely with Product Managers and Marketing Communications on every product you touch. These are your primary partners for testing, launching, and improving
Navigate across Product, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, Data, Design, and Marketing to move work forward
Adapt priorities quickly as business needs shift 
Contribute to team documentation so insights and learnings can be shared across teams


Qualifications

Required


1–2 years of experience in Product Marketing, Growth, Consumer Research, or a related field.
Strong analytical thinking and comfort working with qualitative feedback, behavioral data, and survey results
Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
Clear, concise communicator who can turn complexity into a sharp insight or recommendation
Curious about AI tools and eager to use them to work smarter. Bonus if you're already using them regularly


Nice to Have


Consumer-facing or mobile product experience
Familiarity with user research methodologies, NPS analysis, or customer interview programs
Experience with lifecycle messaging, in-product copy, or Braze (or similar)
Background in fintech, subscriptions, or marketplace businesses


About You:


You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

About the job

HoopStars | Parent-company Marketing Team Lead

Full-time. Remote from LATAM. Toronto working hours. Potential future relocation to the US or Canada by mutual agreement.

Build the business. Build the marketing team.

HoopStars is a Toronto-based youth basketball business with recurring customers and technology-enabled operations. We are looking for a hands-on General Manager whose strongest skills are marketing, ecommerce and profitable growth, and who can take responsibility for the whole business.

You will divide your time approximately equally between running HoopStars and building and managing the parent company Community Sports Partners' marketing team across its brands. This is one vacancy advertised across multiple locations. Candidates elsewhere in LATAM are also welcome; apply once using your preferred location listing.

You should understand how to turn advertising into customers, improve conversion, increase repeat purchases and make the numbers work. You will also own budgets, operating performance and the team delivering the customer experience.

What You Will Own


Run HoopStars: Own its business plan, budget, revenue, profitability and cash forecasts. Lead sales and operations, ensuring programmes, coaches, venues and service quality keep pace with demand
Drive digital growth: Improve paid search and social, creative, landing pages, enrollment funnels, pricing, offers, referrals and retention
Build the parent marketing team: Define the structure, recruit specialists, appoint contractors or agencies where useful, and manage priorities and performance across brands
Establish commercial discipline: Connect campaign performance to paying customers, repeat enrollment and contribution profit. Allocate marketing investment using reliable reporting and testing
Stay close to execution: Inspect advertising accounts, diagnose funnel problems and help launch improvements yourself while building a team that can execute consistently


Support and autonomy

The parent provides bookkeeping assistance, HR support, IT and website support, and a local manager covering customer service and day-to-day sales. You will propose budgets and team plans, then make operating decisions within agreed authority. After onboarding, the founder expects a monthly business review, supported by clear weekly reporting and escalation of exceptional issues.

Your first 90 days

Understand the customers, operations and economics. Audit marketing across the brands. Establish reporting, propose the marketing team structure and hiring priorities, launch the first growth tests, and take ownership of normal HoopStars business decisions.

Requirements

Who we are looking for

You may have built an ecommerce business, led growth for a consumer brand, run a digital agency with meaningful operating responsibility, or managed a business where digital acquisition was central to its success.


Demonstrated results in paid acquisition, conversion and retention
Commercial responsibility beyond a marketing budget: pricing, margins, staffing, forecasts or business profitability
Experience hiring and managing marketers, creatives, agencies or other specialists
Ability to translate ecommerce methods into a service business with real delivery capacity and customer commitments
Comfort doing practical work while developing people and systems
Strong professional English and effective remote leadership


Experience in youth sports, education, fitness, memberships or multi-location services is useful. Evidence of building a profitable business and an effective team matters most.

How To Apply

Submit your CV through this application form. Describe a business or brand you grew, including spend, results and your personal contribution; a team you built or managed; and a commercial decision that failed and what you changed afterward.

Complete both standard assessments before or shortly after applying, using the same email address as your application. If you have already completed them for Community Sports Partners using that email, indicate this in the form.


Culture Index survey
Criteria GAME assessment - English


Benefits

Compensation commensurate with experience and qualifications.

Remote work from LATAM, with Toronto-hours collaboration. Opportunity to build and lead a business and the parent marketing team, with equity opportunity subject to agreed terms. Potential future relocation to the US or Canada by mutual agreement.

The commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated.
With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better commerce experience to our users. We are looking for passionate and talented people to join our operations team, together we can build a commerce ecosystem that is innovative, secure and intuitive for our users.

We are looking for a marketer with an analytical mind and creative to work on our creator ecosystem. You will be a strategic and executing part of the go-to-market of the program. Focusing on analyzing channels and communities to understand what creators need at every stage of their journey. You will also design and produce the marketing pieces that accelerate their growth, grow our own channels, and maintain a close relationship with the community. You will work directly with the Creator Marketing Lead and with stakeholders in Brand Marketing, Operations, Partner Management and regional teams.

Responsibilities:
- In charge of TikTok Shop Creator Incubation and Growth Program
- Design the Creator Matchmaking program to connect creators with brands efficiently
- Conduct creator research, interviews, webinars and events to create better creator marketing and awareness
- Optimize creator level and ecosystem through product and operation strategy
- Identify growth levers, communication gaps and opportunities per segment
- Translate channel and community performance findings into creative briefs
- Build message frameworks by creator journey stage - from awareness to discovery - and land them on concrete pieces with measurable results
- Produce the marketing pieces that execute the strategy with creative quality and branded voice.
- Design and run marketing experiments with clear metrics before scaling.
- Coordinate with freelancers, agencies and the internal design/video team to ensure timely deliverables

- Knowledge of TikTok and content creators.

Preferred Qualification(s)

As a Paid Search Specialist, you will execute and optimize Paid Search and Shopping campaigns to drive efficient client growth. About the job

About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Summary And Impact

As part of the Global Operations Centre (GOC), you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. We are looking for a Senior Executive Programmatic who will:


Interact effectively with regional teams (Europe, U.S., Asia) and be a strong communicator. 
Support DV360, YouTube TrueView and other DSPs campaign launches and setup according to WPP Media established guidelines. 
Ensure campaigns comply with WPP Media’s global policies and guidelines.

Produce daily campaign reports, including daily pacing, data inputting, and providing commentary to regional Media Activation teams. 


Skills And Experience

If this opportunity looks right for you, we are looking for candidates who have:


Bachelor’s degree. 
Advanced English level (B2–C2). 
Have 1.5-2 years of implementing and optimizing programmatic campaigns in DV360, The Trade Desk, MediaMath, Xandr and other DSPs. 
Advanced Excel skills. 
Strong analytical and numerical skills. 


Life At WPP Media & Benefits

Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising.

We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits

package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.

WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection in this open and supportive environment. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process. Please note that while our philosophy is the same across WPP, benefits may vary by office/country.

For Mexico

This position is available in a Remote or Hybrid Work Modality. The candidate must perform their work from any location within Mexico. Only Mexican nationals residing in the country or foreign nationals with a valid work permit may apply. Remote work from abroad is not permitted under any circumstances.

For Colombia

This position is in a Remote or Hybrid Work Modality and must be performed within Colombian territory. Only candidates residing in Colombia with a valid work permit may apply. Remote work contracts do not allow employment or relocation abroad.

POWER A WORLD OF TRUST

Incode is the leading provider of world-class identity solutions that is reinventing the way humans authenticate and verify their identities online to power a world of digital trust.

Through our revolutionary identity solutions, we are unleashing the business potential of universal industries including finance, government, retail, hospitality, gaming, and more, by reducing fraud and transforming human interactions with data, products, and services.

Incode is a Series B unicorn ($1.25 B valuation) rewriting how the world proves identity. Our AI-powered platform lets leading banks, fintechs, marketplaces, and governments deliver friction-free experiences while defeating fraud and safeguarding privacy. Customers such as Citi, AirBnB, Block, Chime, Sixt, and TikTok rely on Incode to power their identity verification and security. Recently named a leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Identity Verification, we’re scaling fast—and we need a product-marketing leader who can turn breakthrough technology into a category-defining narrative.

The Impact You’ll Make

We are seeking a highly skilled Backend Engineer to join our team of backend and DevOps experts. In this role, you will design and implement scalable, resilient backend services that power products used by millions of users. You’ll tackle complex engineering challenges, from extracting services from a monolith to designing robust APIs and data migrations, while ensuring performance, stability, and maintainability.
