description:
About the job

UNICEF works in over 190 countries and territories to save children’s lives, defend their rights, and help them fulfill their potential, from early childhood through adolescence.

At UNICEF, we are committed, passionate, and proud of what we do for as long as we are needed. Promoting the rights of every child is not just a job – it is a calling.

UNICEF is a place where careers are built: we offer our staff diverse opportunities for professional and personal development that will help them reinforce a sense of purpose while serving children and communities across the world. We welcome everyone who wants to belong and grow in a diverse and passionate culture, coupled with an attractive compensation and benefits package.

Visit our website to learn more about what we do at UNICEF.

For every child, the right to a future

UNICEF Mexico’s Country Programme Document (CPD) for the period 2026–2031 provides a strategic framework to address emerging challenges and evolving priorities aimed at improving the lives of children across the country. The programme operates through a structure, comprising one Country Office in Mexico City and three Zonal Offices covering the southern, northern, and eastern regions. It is characterized by strong programmatic delivery, complemented by an ambitious national fundraising and brand positioning strategy.

Within this context, UNICEF Mexico prioritizes the strategic use of evidence to inform policy and programme design, the strengthening of partnerships and multistakeholder coalitions, and the delivery of scalable interventions with a particular emphasis on subnational engagement. In parallel, the office is advancing a diversified and sustainable fundraising model anchored in long-term donor engagement, aimed at securing predictable funding for core priorities while further elevating organizational visibility and impact.

How can you make a difference?

The role encompasses both procedural and specialized functions related to ICT systems, including desktop administration, connectivity, and server support. It involves the installation, configuration, and routine maintenance of ICT components, as well as user support and orientation. In addition, the position ensures the efficient management of service requests, maintenance of technical and user documentation, and adherence to organizational standards, thereby contributing to the overall effectiveness, reliability, and performance of digital systems in support of UNICEF’s results for children in Mexico.

Key Functions And Responsibilities


General ICT / Office Support 
Minimal ICT Administration
Cybersecurity and General Protection of Digital Assets 
Project and Operational Support 


If you would like to know more about this position, please review the complete Job Description here: JD_Digital Impact Associate_G6.pdf

To qualify as a champion for every child you will have…

Minimum Requirements


Education: Completion of Secondary education is required. A bachelor’s degree from a recognized academic institution in a field relevant to the position may replace three years of related work experience. A master’s degree may replace an additional two years.
Work Experience: Minimum six years of practical work experience in information technology, requiring systematic methods of troubleshooting and problem solving is required.
Skills: Demonstrated ability to provide IT support and troubleshooting technical issues is required.
Language Requirements: Proficient Spanish and Intermediate English are required.


Desirables


Language: Knowledge of another official UN language (Arabic, Chinese, French, or Russian) is an asset. Proficiency in English is an advantage.
Professional and/or university courses in Information Systems, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Network Engineering, Telecommunications, or other related fields are highly desirable.
Knowledge of network and systems administration, cybersecurity and data protection is considered an asset.

Experience with AI tools is desirable.
Experience providing ICT support within the United Nations system, NGOs, or other multicultural environments is an asset.
Experience in disaster recovery testing is desirable.
Relevant experience at country level, particularly in development, fragile settings and humanitarian contexts is an asset.


For every Child, you demonstrate...

UNICEF's Core Values of Care, Respect, Integrity, Trust and Accountability and Sustainability (CRITAS) underpin everything we do and how we do it. Get acquainted with Our Values Charter: UNICEF Values

UNICEF Competencies Required For This Post Are…


 Builds and maintains partnerships
 Demonstrates self-awareness and ethical awareness
 Drive to achieve results for impact
 Innovates and embraces change
 Manages ambiguity and complexity
 Thinks and acts strategically
 Works collaboratively with others


Familiarize yourself with our competency framework and its different levels.

UNICEF promotes and advocates for the protection of the rights of every child, everywhere, in everything it does and is mandated to support the realization of the rights of every child, including those most disadvantaged, and our global workforce must reflect the diversity of those children. The UNICEF family is committed to include everyone, irrespective of their race/ethnicity, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, socio-economic background, minority, or any other status.

UNICEF encourages applications from all qualified candidates, regardless of gender, nationality, religious or ethnic backgrounds, and from people with disabilities, including neurodivergence. We offer a wide range of benefits to our staff, including paid parental leave, breastfeeding breaks and reasonable accommodation for persons with disabilities. UNICEF provides reasonable accommodation throughout the recruitment process. If you require any accommodation, please submit your request through the accessibility email button on the UNICEF Careers webpage Accessibility | UNICEF. Should you be shortlisted, please get in touch with the recruiter directly to share further details, enabling us to make the necessary arrangements in advance.

UNICEF does not hire candidates who are married to children (persons under 18). UNICEF has a zero-tolerance policy on conduct that is incompatible with the aims and objectives of the United Nations and UNICEF, including sexual exploitation and abuse, sexual harassment, abuse of authority, discrimination, fraud, corruption and other forms of serious misconduct. UNICEF is committed to promoting the protection and safeguarding of all children. All selected candidates will undergo rigorous reference, safeguarding and background verification checks. These checks may include verification of academic credentials and employment history, screening against relevant United Nations misconduct databases, and requests for misconduct disclosures from current and former employers, professional associations, other relevant organizations and participating organizations under inter-agency safeguarding initiatives, including the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme (MDS), where applicable. Appointment, selection and continued engagement are subject to the satisfactory completion of all required checks. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information and consent to enable UNICEF to undertake these checks. Background checks will include the verification of academic credential(s) and employment history. Selected candidates may be required to provide additional information to conduct a background check, and selected candidates with disabilities may be requested to submit supporting documentation in relation to their disability confidentially.

UNICEF appointments are subject to medical clearance. Appointments are conditional on the selected candidates willingness to comply with current or future vaccination requirements, should UNICEF mandate it for personnel. Failure to comply with such requirements, where applicable and without a duly approved medical exemption from the relevant UN authority, will result in the cancellation of the selection or may lead to other administrative measures, including separation from service.

Remarks

As per Article 101, paragraph 3, of the Charter of the United Nations, the paramount consideration in the employment of the staff is the necessity of securing the highest standards of efficiency, competence, and integrity.

UNICEF is committed to fostering an inclusive, representative, and welcoming workforce. For this position, eligible and suitable candidates from underrepresented groups, including persons with disabilities, indigenous peoples, and Afro-descendant communities, are encouraged to apply.

Government employees who are considered for employment with UNICEF are normally required to resign from their government positions before taking up an assignment with UNICEF. UNICEF reserves the right to withdraw an offer of appointment, without compensation, if a visa or medical clearance is not obtained, or necessary inoculation requirements are not met, within a reasonable period for any reason.

Humanitarian action is a cross-cutting priority within UNICEF's Strategic Plan. UNICEF is committed to stay and deliver in humanitarian contexts. Therefore, all staff, at all levels across all functional areas, can be called upon to be deployed to support humanitarian response, contributing to both strengthening resilience of communities and capacity of national authorities.

Important: For GS category positions, only candidates who are nationals of the country or that hold a valid work permit or residency status will be considered.

All UNICEF positions are advertised, and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted and advance to the next stage of the selection process. An internal candidate performing at the level of the post in the relevant functional area, or an internal/external candidate in the corresponding Talent Group, may be selected, if suitable for the post, without assessment of other candidates.

Additional information about working for UNICEF can be found here.

description:
About the job

PoderJudicialVirtual.com | 100% remoto 




Resumen del rol

Buscamos al ingeniero que se sumará al equipo que va a construir el próximo producto de PoderJudicialVirtual de punta a punta y llevarlo a producción. Es un rol de constructor dentro de un equipo de desarrollo: entre todos toman la especificación, diseñan el backend en Laravel, construyen el frontend en Vue, integran los pagos con Stripe y lo lanzan a miles de usuarios reales. Con ownership real de tu parte del producto, sin capas intermedias y sin nadie revisándote el hombro.

No es un asiento más en una fábrica de software. Estamos ejecutando nuestro plan 2030: pasar de 2 productos en producción a 11 y expandirnos a Sudamérica. Tú construyes el primero de esa nueva ola, y quien construye bien aquí se convierte en pieza central de todo lo que sigue. El crecimiento se gana construyendo, no por antigüedad.

Te integrarás a un equipo de desarrollo en México, de la mano de un líder técnico fuerte, dueño de la arquitectura y la infraestructura, y de un Product Manager Senior que te entrega specs claras con Definition of Ready y Definition of Done. Tú eres dueño del código: de que escale, de que cobre bien y de que llegue a producción sin sorpresas.

Vas a trabajar sobre un dominio complejo (la infraestructura judicial mexicana) que tarda meses en dominarse. No esperamos que llegues sabiéndolo. Sí esperamos que en pocos meses tomes decisiones técnicas independientes y que tu código hable por ti.




Sobre nosotros

PoderJudicialVirtual es una empresa legaltech mexicana con más de 10 años en el mercado. Operamos la plataforma de datos judiciales más grande de México: más de 65 millones de registros de todo el país, con despachos, empresas y miles de personas usando y pagando el servicio todos los días. Somos rentables y no dependemos de inversionistas para ejecutar nuestro plan.




El proyecto

Arranque en septiembre de 2026. El equipo construirá un producto nuevo completo: backend en Laravel, frontend en Vue, flujo de referidos e integración de pagos con Stripe, desde la spec hasta producción. Al lanzarlo, sigue el próximo producto del plan. Aquí no se mantiene lo de otros: se construye lo propio.




Lo que buscamos




Requisitos:

• 5 años o más de experiencia profesional con PHP, idealmente Laravel.

• Capacidad real de leer, entender y mantener código existente con años de historia, no solo arrancar proyectos desde cero.

• MySQL a escala: has trabajado con tablas de millones de registros y sabes de índices y paginación eficiente.

• Vue.js sólido para trabajo full-stack.

• Diseño y consumo de APIs REST que escalan.

• Ownership: tomas un producto y lo llevas a producción. Detectas tus errores antes de entregar.

• Git con flujo profesional: manejo de branches, pull requests y participación activa en code reviews.

• Entorno de desarrollo Linux: configuración autónoma de stack local en Ubuntu (Apache, PHP, MySQL) sin dependencia de soporte externo.




Deseable (suma puntos, no descarta):

• MongoDB, 2 años o más.

• Automatización web: experiencia con Playwright, Puppeteer y gestión de proxies.

• Cloud: familiaridad con servicios de AWS.

• Inglés de lectura técnica: entender documentación, errores y recursos de desarrollo en inglés. No se requiere hablarlo.

• Experiencia integrando pasarelas de pago; Stripe en particular.




Sobre el uso de IA

Usamos IA todos los días y esperamos que tú también. La regla es simple: la IA amplifica tu criterio, no lo sustituye. Debes entender cada línea que mandas a producción. Durante el proceso vas a defender tu código en vivo, sin asistentes: explicar tus decisiones, encontrar errores en código ajeno y modificar comportamiento en tiempo real.




Soft skills (competencias clave que valoramos):

• Criterio técnico en revisión de código. Capacidad para identificar vulnerabilidades, cuellos de botella y errores de lógica, tanto en código propio como en el generado por IA.

• Ownership del resultado. Asumir plena responsabilidad sobre el código entregado. La IA es una herramienta; las decisiones y sus consecuencias son del desarrollador.

• Autonomía operativa. Capacidad para tomar un proyecto, definir el camino y ejecutarlo de principio a fin. Esperamos consultas estratégicas, no acompañamiento constante.

• Documentación de decisiones. Más allá del código, registrar el razonamiento detrás de las decisiones de arquitectura: el "por qué" que da contexto a futuras iteraciones del equipo.




Lo que ofrecemos

100% remoto.
Sueldo entre $65,000 y $80,000 brutos, acordes a tu experiencia.
Bono por objetivos ligado a que tu producto llegue a producción y cobre.
Impacto directo: lo que construyes lo usan miles de abogados y empresas desde el día uno.
Un plan 2030 real, con productos definidos y financiamiento propio, del que tu trabajo es pieza central.




Cómo aplicar

About The Team

Zillow started in 2006 and is the most visited real estate website in the United States with over 10.5 billion visits in 2022, and an average of 220 million monthly unique users. Zillow helps high-intent movers find and win their home through digital solutions and first class partners. Our Zillow Mexico team will work with our US tech teams to simplify and automate the buying, selling and renting experience to make home a reality for more and more people.

We believe that creativity, collaboration, and innovation lead to success.

We actively encourage our teams to learn about the business and share their ideas.

We value and promote a diverse and inclusive workplace!

About The Role

We are looking for a strong Senior iOS Engineer who holds their code to high standards and who is not afraid to give feedback on the product.


We have teams working to give people the power to manage and ingest lots of media and data. Looking for an engineer that can help lead the teams’ technology stacks to ensure we’re building the more robust, scalable, and affordable systems. Work on the latest iOS technologies and architectural patterns to develop world-class mobile applications. 
Being customer-focused and adaptable in multi-functional partnerships is highly desirable.  We embrace agile software development practices, and believe deeply in building teams composed of all skills needed to deliver value (SDE, PM, SDM, SQE, Design, DE, etc).

Consistently deliver performant, testable, scalable, highly-readable code using architecture and design best practices


This role has been categorized as a teleworker position. Teleworkers do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and instead work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. Employees may live anywhere in Mexico, with availability to travel to Mexico City, as we recommend attendance at occasional office events.

In addition to a competitive base salary and benefits, this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location.

Who you are

This role is a strong fit for self-motivated engineers who are passionate about both the business and the technology behind it. Deep knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, and Node.js is essential, and hands-on experience with React, Redux, Jest, Azure SQL, and MongoDB is a strong plus. Develop and maintain web applications using modern web technologies.

Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.
Ensure the performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications.

Experience with database systems such as MongoDB, MSSQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or similar.
Experience working on large single-page web applications with complex state management.
Familiarity with UI frameworks such as Bootstrap, Semantic UI React, Material, Tailwind, or similar.
Experience writing unit and integration tests using tools such as Jest, Chai, Cypress, or similar.
Experience performing code reviews to ensure security, code quality, maintainability, and knowledge sharing across the team.
Familiarity with version control systems such as Git.
Solid understanding of RESTful APIs and web services.
Very strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.


Preferred Experience

The ideal candidate is a seasoned full stack engineer who takes ownership of quality, from clean code and solid test coverage to thoughtful code reviews. Just as important as technical depth is the ability to adapt to changing technology, understand the business context behind the work, and contribute to a team culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.

title: Diseñador/a Frontend - Experiencia de Usuario
skills: Diseñar y desarrollar sitios web, landings, formularios y emails con foco en la experiencia del usuario.
Tomar decisiones de diseño considerando jerarquía visual, espaciado, legibilidad, accesibilidad y experiencia móvil.
Trabajar sobre código existente, comprender su estructura y realizar mejoras de manera ordenada, en colaboración con otros desarrolladores y equipos.
Utilizar herramientas de IA como Codex, ChatGPT, Claude o Copilot para optimizar procesos de trabajo, con criterio para revisar, validar y mejorar los resultados generados.
Proponer mejoras y desarrollar componentes y plantillas reutilizables.
Cuidar la calidad visual y funcional de cada implementación hasta su entrega final.
De 2 a 4 años de experiencia diseñando y desarrollando sitios o experiencias digitales en producción.
Buen criterio visual y atención al detalle en aspectos como espaciado, tipografía, contraste, jerarquía y consistencia.
Capacidad para argumentar y comunicar las decisiones de diseño.
Dominio de HTML semántico y CSS, incluyendo Grid, Flexbox y diseño responsive.
Conocimientos sólidos de JavaScript vanilla para desarrollar interacciones, validaciones de formularios y manipulación del DOM sin depender necesariamente de un framework.
Experiencia con Tailwind y/o Bootstrap.
Conocimiento de buenas prácticas de accesibilidad (WCAG) y optimización de performance, especialmente en dispositivos móviles.
Experiencia trabajando de manera colaborativa con Git y sobre bases de código desarrolladas por otros equipos o personas.
Interés por nuevas tecnologías y apertura para proponer mejores formas de resolver problemas.
Portafolio que incluya proyectos en los que hayas participado tanto en el diseño como en el desarrollo.
Figma u otras herramientas de diseño de interfaces.
AMPscript, SSJS o Salesforce Marketing Cloud. Si aún no tienes experiencia con estas tecnologías, podrás aprenderlas con el equipo.
Desarrollo de emails en HTML, incluyendo tablas, estilos inline y pruebas de compatibilidad entre clientes de correo.
Microinteracciones y animaciones con CSS.
Entornos de agencia o proyectos relacionados con las industrias del deporte y el entretenimiento.
